label: post_hoc_secondary
label_reason: a faithfulness secondary was declared on 2026-10-22, but the family and this analysis were fixed on 2026-10-31, after the final523 primary outcome was known; the result cannot change the confirmatory label of final523
decision_source: user, 2026-10-31: plan 261031-2136-rq2-summarization-completion; margin and rater use the plan's proposed defaults and may be edited only before the first score
question: on the final523 compared IDs, are LED ngram3 outputs less supported by their source than BART outputs, by more than the practical margin, in a way not explained by a different false-flag rate of the scorer

inputs.bundle: tib-final523-scoring-261024-v1.zip (private; scoring_outputs.jsonl holds source, delivered_summary and the S/M/L views of every cell)
inputs.bundle_sha256_source: research-data/tib-final523-scoring-261024-v1 and the registry copy of the scoring package manifest
inputs.not_scored: cells with scoreable=false (4 LED failures) stay as NULL rows in the denominator and are never scored as zero
inputs.cohort: C_final = IDs where both LED and BART are scoreable (519 expected: short 182, medium 170, long 167)
inputs.integrity: sha256 of source and delivered_summary must match source_sha256 and delivered_sha256 of the row; a mismatch stops the run

metric.pin_note: the Pilot40 run installed @main (package 0.1.0) on 2026-10-22/23; b58b9fa is the repository HEAD on 2026-10-31 and is the pin from now on; the installed version and environment are written to the receipt
metric.environment_reference: Pilot40 receipt: torch 2.11.0+cu130, transformers 5.20.1, nltk 3.9.1, Tesla T4
metric.unit: each sentence of the delivered summary (tib_summary_constructors.split_sentences) scored against the whole normalized source

record_scores.mean_prob: mean of the sentence probabilities of the view (primary statistic of this protocol)
record_scores.flagged_share: share of sentences with probability below 0.5 (secondary)

metric.known_validity: Pilot40 sentence review (2026-10-23): 8/27 flagged sentences fully supported (30%, Wilson 16-48%), more often in multi-idea abstractive sentences; 17/18 unflagged sentences supported. Not validated against human judgment beyond that sample.

views.contract: delivered_summary (the 350-word contract view that was scored for ROUGE-L); reported as the main view
views.S: the stored 60-word view; length-matched sensitivity because LED outputs are much longer than BART outputs
views.M_L: the stored 120/240-word views are derived from the same sentence scores and reported descriptively
views.scoring: each distinct sentence of the contract, S, M and L texts is scored once; a forced word cut makes a truncated sentence that is scored as its own claim

analysis.contrast: LED - BART, per record, on C_final
analysis.bootstrap: stratified percentile bootstrap by source stratum (tib_final523_analysis.bootstrap), records resampled within stratum
analysis.multiplicity: none: one primary statistic (mean_prob, contract view); all other cells are descriptive
analysis.descriptive: per profile and stratum means with record counts; Lead-3 and LexRank are not scored (extractive; Pilot40 flagged 3/120 and 4/579 of their sentences)

hand_review.rater: Claude, one rater, as in the Pilot40 review; no inter-rater agreement
hand_review.sample: contract-view sentences from the private detail file; for each profile x stratum, 4 flagged and 2 unflagged sentences drawn at random with seed 20261031 (72 sentences); drawn by tib_final523_faithfulness.draw_review_sample before the contrast table is read

labels.P: main point right, a detail wrong, invented or overstated
labels.U: source does not say it or contradicts it

hand_review.false_flag_rate: S among flagged sentences of the profile, with a Wilson 95% interval; N excluded from the denominator

interpretation.led_less_faithful: all of: (1) the 95% interval of LED - BART mean_prob on the contract view is entirely below 0; (2) the mean difference is <= -0.05; (3) the Wilson intervals of the two profiles' false-flag rates overlap. Result: post-hoc evidence that LED is less faithful; present the 2026-10-26 BART fallback option to the user. Nothing is switched automatically.
interpretation.led_more_faithful: the mirror of the rule above (interval entirely above 0, difference >= 0.05, overlapping false-flag intervals); recorded, no change of choice
interpretation.otherwise: no faithfulness difference established; LED stays the choice; limits are reported
interpretation.completeness: a directional label needs C_final = 519 and zero error rows; error rows are retried by rerunning the notebook (never scored as zero, never dropped); if errors persist, the label is not_evaluable and the descriptive tables are reported with their denominators
interpretation.limitation: with about 12 flagged sentences per profile the Wilson intervals of the false-flag rates almost always overlap, so condition (3) guards only against a large difference; report this with the result
interpretation.never: the result does not change the final523 confirmatory label, is not a factuality percentage and is not evidence for the multimodal pipeline

order: scoring prints no score; the hand-review sample is drawn from the private detail file before the contrast table is computed locally

budget.estimate: Pilot40 scored 191 records in 2,047 s on a T4 (about 10.7 s per record at up to 240 words); 1,042 cells at up to 350 words: about 3-5 GPU hours
budget.stop_rule: every record is checkpointed; after the first 10 records (spread over both profiles and strata) the projected total is checked against the ceiling; scoring stops before a record would pass the ceiling; then ask for more budget, never drop records to fit

outputs.receipt: final523_faithfulness_receipt.json (record scores, environment, MiniCheck pin, first-score and receipt UTC times; error rows carry only the exception type; no sentence text)
outputs.private_detail: PRIVATE_final523_sentence_scores.jsonl (sentence text and probability; private Drive and local machine only, never in the repository)
outputs.analysis: final523_faithfulness_analysis.json written by tib_final523_faithfulness.analyze from the receipt
